description: The bar chart illustrates execution accuracy results for two methods (one labeled in the legend as “NatSQL” shown in light blue, and a second method shown in darker blue with its legend text not visible) across four difficulty categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total,” presented left to right in that order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” with a linear numeric scale showing tick marks from about 20 up to 60 at regular 10-unit intervals. Each category contains a grouped pair of vertical bars: for “Simple,” the light-blue NatSQL bar is labeled 60.21 and the dark-blue bar is labeled 63.14; for “Moderate,” NatSQL is 39.64 and the dark-blue bar is 48.60; for “Challenging,” NatSQL is 32.32 and the dark-blue bar is 36.11; and for “Total,” NatSQL is 51.35 and the dark-blue bar is 56.19. The bars are not shown as stacked, there are no error bars, and each bar has its value annotated above it; the categories appear in a fixed difficulty/summary order rather than being sorted by bar height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the two-color grouping and numeric labels.
